name_zh: 端点约束的轨迹分布桥
formal_object: Finite model-derived correspondence states; reference Markov path law Q(i_1:T)=q_1(i_1) product K_t(i_t,i_t+1); specified endpoint marginals r_1,r_T.

operations.condition: Reference law is normalized with adequate endpoint support

operations.input: min_P KL(P||Q) subject to endpoint marginals
operations.condition: Endpoint constraints are feasible under Q support

derivation_steps.statement: Stationarity of KL plus endpoint multipliers yields P*(path)=u(i_1) Q(path) v(i_T).
derivation_steps.justification: Differentiate over normalized path masses; scaling factors absorb normalization.

derivation_steps.statement: Forward/backward messages compute endpoint marginals without enumerating all paths.
derivation_steps.justification: Sum the factorized law through the finite state chain.

derivation_steps.statement: Alternate endpoint scaling until both marginal residuals close.
derivation_steps.justification: This is a KL bridge, not proof that the chosen endpoints identify true surface motion.

assumptions: Endpoint distributions come from declared allowed model observations and are not GT labels.
Structural zeros can make the bridge infeasible; support cannot be repaired by huge weights.
A Markov approximation may omit relevant long-range dependence.
Marginal closure does not imply correct point identity or geometry.
method_expression: Construct the sparse reference chain, apply endpoint KL projection by forward/backward messages, and derive a coherent path decision with the common output lift.
distinguishing_prediction: Future endpoint evidence can change intermediate correspondence paths without only smoothing coordinates; benefit should disappear when endpoint evidence is uninformative.
falsifier: Reject if a local transition smoother or historical decoder-cycle repair with equal inference budget supplies the same native benefit.
closest_alternative: Classical Schrödinger/IPF bridge; local Markov tracking; historical m02 decoder cycle consistency acts on a different object.
decisive_comparison: Reference chain, local smoothing and endpoint bridge under the same candidates/calls; native task and scorer unchanged; endpoint evidence frozen before confirmation.
operational_delta: Constrains an entire path probability law rather than adding pairwise cycle penalties or per-frame temperature.
feasibility_and_cost: Sparse forward/backward messages; reliable endpoint likelihoods and attention/candidate interfaces remain unqualified.
structural_signature: Path-distribution KL projection with two endpoint marginals.
algebra_review_basis: Verified multiplier factorization and support/normalization obligations. Neither forward-backward inference nor a bridge establishes correct semantic identity.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
